traits.name: Burning Grasp
traits.text: (fire); When the efreeti grabs a creature, that creature takes 2d6 (2d6) fire damage, and takes 2d6 (2d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns as long as it remains grabbed.

traits.name: Change Size
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, concentrate, polymorph, transmutation); Frequency once per day Effect The efreeti changes a creature's size. This works as a 4th-level enlarge or shrink spell but can target an unwilling creature (DC 29 Fortitude save negates).

traits.name: Combat Grab
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The efreeti has one hand free. Effect The efreeti makes a melee Strike while keeping one hand free. If the Strike hits, the target is grabbed in the efreeti's free hand.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ scimitar +21 (fire, forceful +2, magical, reach 10 feet, sweep); Damage 2d6+11 (2d6+11) slashing plus 2d6 (2d6) fire

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +20 (agile, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 1d4+11 (1d4+11) bludgeoning plus 2d6 (2d6) fire
